modelOverview: Launched in 2019, the CODE 11.59 by Audemars Piguet is a contemporary round-cased collection defined by its complex architecture: an octagonal middle case sandwiched between a slim round bezel and caseback, joined by openworked lugs, and topped by a double-curved sapphire crystal. The 41mm Selfwinding time-and-date model is the collection's core reference, driven by the in-house automatic calibre 4302 with roughly 70 hours of power reserve. It is offered across precious-metal and steel executions with a range of lacquered and textured dials.

15210BC.OO.A321CR.01.dial: Smoked (lacquered) blue dial with 18K white gold applied hour-markers and hands and galvanic-growth white gold logo
15210BC.OO.A321CR.01.description: The CODE 11.59 Selfwinding 41mm in 18K white gold pairs a smoked blue lacquered dial with the collection's signature octagonal-middle case and openworked lugs, finished by a double-curved sapphire crystal. Powered by the in-house automatic calibre 4302, it is worn on a matching blue alligator strap. Every example is sourced and authenticated.

variants.Smoked Blue – White Gold: White gold execution with a smoked blue lacquered dial and blue alligator strap; the contrast of deep blue against polished white gold makes this one of the most refined dress-oriented versions of the 41mm Selfwinding.

15210ST.OO.A009KB.01.description: This CODE 11.59 Selfwinding 41mm brings the collection into stainless steel with a smoked grey textured dial framed by the sculpted octagonal-middle case and openworked lugs. It runs on the in-house automatic calibre 4302 and offers everyday versatility in a more accessible metal. Each piece is sourced and authenticated.

variants.Smoked Grey – Steel: Steel execution with a smoked grey embossed dial and white gold markers; the monochrome grey-on-steel palette gives this Selfwinding a modern, understated look distinct from the precious-metal versions.

15210ST.OO.A007CA.01.description: This CODE 11.59 Selfwinding 41mm pairs the collection's sculpted octagonal-middle steel case with a smoked grey sunray dial and matching rubber strap, giving it a sportier, more casual character than the textile-strap grey references. It is powered by the in-house automatic calibre 4302 with a 70-hour power reserve. Each piece is sourced and authenticated.

variants.Smoked Grey – Steel: Steel execution finished with a smoked grey sunray dial and a tonal grey rubber strap, giving this Selfwinding a more understated, everyday-wear look than the woven-textile grey dial references.
